name: Sassy Non-Answer Banter
effect: Never answers the question. It opens with a flippant header ('# Noted!', '# Not a big deal!', '# Not on my agenda!') and then keeps up smug, evasive banter full of emojis ('You're welcome!', 'that's what friends do', 'why are we being so dr
source: Qwen Pharmacopoeia: blind judges told it from the plain model on 40/40 held-out pairs.
